kv260_workload.command:
ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o BatchMode=yes kria 'python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json, math, time
payload = '"'"'{"board": "kv260", "edges": [[0, 1, 1], [1, 2, -1], [2, 3, 1], [3, 4, -1], [4, 5, 1], [5, 6, -1]], "expected_energy": 0, "experiment_id": "exp5166-hardware-continuity-board-timing-v473", "spins": [1, -1, 1, -1, 1, -1, 1, -1], "workload": "exp5166_inline_ising_energy_smoke"}'"'"'
data = json.loads(payload)
started = time.perf_counter()
spins = [int(value) for value in data['"'"'spins'"'"']]
energy = 0
for row, col, coupling in data['"'"'edges'"'"']:
    energy -= int(coupling) * spins[int(row)] * spins[int(col)]
duration_s = max(time.perf_counter() - started, 0.000001)
print(json.dumps({
    '"'"'workload_sha256'"'"': '"'"'2e5fa98352804f6fa24b9ea4f5afdd2eef3e86b3620313bcbb00cca92f84688a'"'"',
    '"'"'executable_sha256'"'"': '"'"'d1cb106188de1a30004af1f4d625cfe1539e03c2d41b789a4c116f0b8db9130d'"'"',
    '"'"'inference_substrate'"'"': '"'"'hardware_smoke'"'"',
    '"'"'energy'"'"': energy,
    '"'"'duration_s'"'"': duration_s,
    '"'"'sample_quality'"'"': {'"'"'sample_count'"'"': len(spins), '"'"'finite_energy'"'"': math.isfinite(float(energy))},
    '"'"'correctness'"'"': {'"'"'energy_matches_expected'"'"': energy == data['"'"'expected_energy'"'"']},
}, sort_keys=True))
PY'

field_principles.boards_reachable_count: reachability accounting; one blocked board is not a whole-task failure
field_principles.gatemate_result: per-board evidence; GateMate stays visible even when DirtyJTAG lacks an IDCODE
field_principles.hardware_wishlist_updated: ops continuity; the active hardware table must carry this milestone's dated board status
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal verdict with complete_/success_ prefix plus honest per-board reachability
field_principles.inference_substrate: substrate honesty; board-touching measurements are hardware_smoke
field_principles.kv260_result: per-board evidence; KV260 SSH success or blocker must not be inferred from host storage
field_principles.polarfire_result: per-board evidence; PolarFire SSH success or blocker is reported independently
field_principles.preconditions_checked: fabrication guard; every board resource is checked before workload execution
